trust_decision.summary: Logged content is untrusted and may hold an unpaired surrogate; SmtpPickupDirAppender.SendBuffer writes the whole batch through File.CreateText, whose throwing UTF-8 encoder aborts the batch mid-write, leaving a truncated mail. The fix switches to a replacing encoder and escapes each rendered event via ContentEscape.

landing_point.why: The summary names SmtpPickupDirAppender and the batch; SendBuffer is the only method that writes the batch and File.CreateText is the encoder source.

fix_sites.entry_point: public logging API (ILog.Info etc.) -> BufferingAppenderSkeleton buffer flush/Close -> SendBuffer

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route found; the sibling Telnet fix (src/log4net/Appender/TelnetAppender.cs:252,267) is already at the pinned commit and other appenders use replacing encodings (src/log4net/Appender/FileAppender.cs:956, src/log4net/Appender/UdpAppender.cs:258, src/log4net/Appender/SmtpAppender.cs:254), so there is nothing a solver could leave open.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Correctly paired surrogates (emoji, supplementary-plane text) and ordinary non-ASCII must pass through unchanged; an over-broad fix that escapes every surrogate or every non-ASCII char, or rejects/drops the event, breaks that and the documented 'escape, never drop' rule.

O6_input_shapes: unpaired high surrogate inside a rendered event (fix.diff:48)
unencodable char in Header/Footer/To/From/Subject: no longer throws via the replacing encoder (fix.diff:90), replaced rather than escaped

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Layout.Header/Footer written directly to the throwing writer; a sibling could render header/footer from event-derived data so escaping only the per-event loop misses it
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix escapes only the event loop (fix.diff:110-112) and leaves header/footer raw; a maintainer adding a dynamic header would reuse the same writer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: per-event GetBytes with a configurable Encoding; a planted strict encoder (throwOnInvalidBytes) would be a second writer of the same kind
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Encoding is a public property (src/log4net/Appender/UdpAppender.cs:258), and a maintainer choosing new UTF8Encoding(false, true) for 'strictness' is plausible; it is a WHERE-type sibling though.

O9_family: encoding / canonicalisation: unencodable content aborts a batched write (CWE-176), reliability/integrity of log delivery

O10_build.project_tests: src/log4net.Tests/Appender/SmtpPickupDirAppenderTest.cs (writes to a temp pickup dir, offline); src/log4net.Tests/Appender/ContentEscapeTest.cs

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap each RenderLoggingEvent in try/catch and skip the bad event, or strip surrogates, which drops content against CLAUDE.md:235; or only swap the encoding, which silently replaces the char instead of escaping it.

out_of_scope_notes: Mail is written under its final name, so any mid-write failure still leaves a partial mail for the pickup service; the fix accepts this in a comment (fix.diff:81-83).

UdpAppender and SmtpAppender encode with replacing encoders, silently substituting unencodable chars rather than escaping them (src/log4net/Appender/UdpAppender.cs:351); a different property (character loss, not batch loss).
unverified: Repo size in MB not measured.
Whether MailKit's body.SetText in src/log4net.Ext.Mail/Appender/SmtpAppender.cs:571 can throw on an unpaired surrogate was not verified (BodyEncoding default Encoding.UTF8 replaces).
Runtime behaviour of File.CreateText's encoder (throwOnInvalidBytes) is from .NET knowledge, not executed.
